title: calliandra pittieri var. polyphylla
intro: Calliandra pittieri var. polyphylla, commonly known as the Mexican bird of paradise or fairy duster, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Calliandra pittieri var. polyphylla include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are also attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiseptic properties.
